profile.headline: Software Developer III @ Velera | Full-Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript | Building CMS platforms, marketing automation, and design systems for fintech
profile.summary: I'm a Software Developer III on Velera's Marketing Technology team, where I build the web platforms, internal tools, and UI systems behind our marketing sites.  Most of my work lives across the full stack in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Lately I've been focused on a multi-tenant architecture that serves multiple brands from one codebase, a shared React component library published to NPM, and CMS tooling that lets marketing teams manage their own content without waiting on a developer.  I like clean code, security-first thinking, and building things that make the people around me faster. Before Velera moved me into this role, I spent a few years modernizing legacy PHP and MODX systems and shipping the tools that replaced them.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
Core contributor to Velera.com, a Next.js and Strapi platform with a reusable component library, GraphQL API, GDPR compliance, automated SEO tooling, and RSS distribution into Seismic.
 
Designed a custom Strapi Form Handler Plugin that removed developer dependency from form deployments, with reCAPTCHA, honeypot bot prevention, cookie-based autofill, XSS sanitization, and real-time Pardot sync.
 
Led security remediation across legacy PHP and MODX systems, including critical CVE patching and zero-downtime deployments; migrated all legacy sites to MODX 3.x.
 
Automated B2C campaign database processes and built reusable UI components that raised development velocity across the team.

positions.title: Website Developer
positions.description:
Cut B2C rebates SPA build time from 1-2 weeks to 2-3 days by rebuilding the PHP template, enabling faster campaign go-to-market.
 
Migrated legacy platforms (Insights, MEC) to Next.js and Strapi, improving performance and content management.
 
Implemented XSS prevention through input validation, parameterized queries against SQL injection, honeypot bot detection, and rate limiting on authentication across web apps.
 
Built self-service MODX tools that let non-technical teams manage content independently, reducing developer dependency.
 
Revamped the Insights page with dynamic lead-gen forms, tag-based filtering, and category-personalized content.
